outcomes.interpretation: At 12 months the hierarchical efficacy endpoint did not differ significantly between groups (win ratio 1.13; P=0.32).

Noninferiority was met in the intention-to-treat population; event counts were 25 Amulet and 24 WATCHMAN patients.
FDA reports 58 Amulet and 53 WATCHMAN subjects with an effectiveness endpoint event; randomized groups had similar five-year ischemic stroke/systemic embolism estimates.
outcomes.limitation: Lower five-year follow-up in the WATCHMAN arm (83.3%) than Amulet (89.2%); comparator is WATCHMAN 2.5.

outcomes.interpretation: Noninferiority was met. The 12-month primary safety analysis is per-protocol among implant attempts as randomized, rather than all randomized participants.

Intraoperative TEE confirmed LAA exclusion in 67 of 70 patients with successful AtriClip placement.
Met superiority for non-procedure-related bleeding by three years; endpoint excludes procedural bleeding.
Met prespecified noninferiority for the three-year efficacy composite; primary event counts were 81 device and 65 anticoagulation patients.

outcomes.interpretation: Primary imaging endpoint was inconclusive.
outcomes.limitation: The confidence interval crosses 1. Clinical event reduction was not established.

outcomes.interpretation: FDA pivotal SSED reports the rate ratio and met noninferiority; the reported credible interval is retained with the source's Bayesian analysis context.
outcomes.limitation: Event-rate denominators are patient-years and differ from randomized patient counts; arm denominator fields show randomized participants for cohort context only.

outcomes.interpretation: Intention-to-treat comparison was not statistically significant. As-treated and per-protocol findings favored Amulet, but are hypothesis generating and do not isolate WATCHMAN FLX because the randomized control arm included WATCHMAN 2.5.
outcomes.limitation: Three-year outcome percentages are Kaplan–Meier estimates; the source reports 80 Amulet and 76 Watchman patients with three-year clinical follow-up. Watchman randomized arm comprised 25 legacy 2.5 and 85 FLX; 3 Amulet-assigned patients received FLX.

outcomes.interpretation: Composite favored TEER; mortality/surgery and HF hospitalization were not demonstrably different.
Mortality was similar; no mortality advantage established.
One-year HF hospitalization rates did not demonstrate a difference.
Fewer recurrent HF hospitalizations through two years.
outcomes.limitation: Abstract reports a one-sided upper confidence limit; nominal level is not specified there. Do not render as a two-sided 95% interval.

outcomes.interpretation: Full-cohort composite result; keep distinct from the initial 350-person estimate.
Technical success was reported in all 21 registry patients; three asymptomatic stent fractures occurred during follow-up.
All 376 patients with evaluable 45-day echocardiography met the primary effectiveness endpoint; complete closure (0 mm leak) was 93.9% in the same study report.
No primary safety endpoint events occurred among 400 patients through 7 days or discharge.
The care program improved medication optimization at six months.
outcomes.limitation: A medication score is not hospitalization, survival, or standalone algorithm efficacy.

outcomes.interpretation: FDA reports adjudicated ischemic stroke/systemic embolism cumulative incidence at 730 days in the implanted analysis set.
outcomes.limitation: 24-month follow-up was 43.1%; high attrition limits certainty despite the Kaplan–Meier method.
